lines.text: ... I confess, the Young Lady Mirror and her contriving did escape my expectation.
My private intent was to accompany her into the Orbital Spire,
and there cut off the enormous core the Queen doubtless willed to use.
Alas, hers was the first move.
My confidence in the quantity of my NIMPH bore negligence; never did thought enter my mind of my NIMPH returning corrupt in such volume.
She didst prey on my NIMPH's nature to return to me. In truth, I was moved with her wit.
In naught but a moment was my NIMPH seized.
Corruption is a detestable thing.
A most painful thing it was, to merely watch through an invisible shroud mine own self act, and not according to my will.
Her command to summon my clones,
to arm them with corruption rods... 'twas an insult I could not abide.
... Before the corruption irrevocably overtaketh me,
I resolved to use this situation.
In my gourd there is always surplus NIMPH.
By my allowance, it doth enter my body from time to time and battle the corruption.
The volume thereof is just less than the corruption, for I have made it so.
Fight though it may, the NIMPH that entereth from the gourd doth fall in its course.
Yet, in that instant of struggle, I recover my wits.
In those moments of opportunity, I did shape my thoughts anew.
No longer do I see myself as mine own self. I now see myself as a method, one which maketh this possible.
True it is, by this same means I might have spurned the corruption the moment of its arrival,
but I did not.
I perceived anon the young lady didst covet me.
Mine ability allured her as a toy too rare to forgo.
I was wholly persuaded she would confine me to the Orbital Spire should I fall into her hands.
That she would leave in my charge an important duty was most certain too, as the Rapture swarm had no wit to merit such.
Even as I thought, so it came to pass. She used me to plot wicked deeds.
'Twas clear she desired to use my clones to corrupt one of the maidens in the Ark,
and when she asked my opinion, I shaped my thoughts to choose Young Lady Dorothy.
Though it was a necessary evil to avoid suspicion, nonetheless I have naught for her but a sorrowful and sorry mind.
Yet I trusted her.
Or rather, I trusted the allies by her side.
And in the end, she once again became a Goddess of Victory.
Haha. What an exquisite delight, to watch through the shroud Young Lady Mirror gnash her teeth.
Afterward, the next needful thing was clear:
to cut off the core of the Orbital Spire within the Queen's transformed body.
Even alone the Queen is a monstrous blight; I could not well allow the use of an energy source of that size by such an one.
As Young Lady Mirror was so taken in game with my clones,
I well knew she would desire to craft a large number to shake the maidens' minds, and thus I shaped my thoughts again.
The clones I created were faulty,
yet the NIMPH I put in them was whole.
... And I gave them the desire for self-destruction.
Two thousand. The selfsame number used before in the battle against the Queen.
They went forth to battle tainted with corruption, and there met their destruction.
The corrupted NIMPH returned to me.
The quantity was unfathomably large; 'twas the NIMPH of two thousand, after all.
Even a fleeting gap I could not create with the NIMPH in my gourd.
Yet, it did not matter.
Wu wei, in a word,
combusts a mighty store of NIMPH to surround my body with an exceeding great deal of energy.
For but a moment, I gain transcendent power.
However, the NIMPH consumed in such manner can never be restored.
Young Lady Mirror's words are true; my vessel cannot contain such a volume of NIMPH.
'Tis possible only for one such as Persinette.
Thus wu wei is, essentially,
a safeguard to protect my mind from ruin should the NIMPH that returns far exceed the limits of my vessel,
while also a secret weapon should I require vast power for a short moment.
A large quantity of NIMPH returned,
an amount to far exceed my capacity,
and was inflamed by wu wei.
Now, there is no NIMPH left in me,
as I did cause all the corrupt NIMPH to combust.
However, the endeavor was worthwhile.
Dorothy was reborn as a Goddess of Victory,
and I did incur wu wei within the Queen.
How didst it feel to play with a broken toy?
Ah, I shall speak not a word of this to Young Lady Mirror.
I have resolved not to speak with the wrongdoers again.
Let them continue to think in their binary.
*Boom!*
Nayuta continues swinging her palms and making a wreck of the area around her.
The interior is covered in palm-shaped holes and explosions.
Dark Matter seeps out and attempts to restore the holes, but Nayuta's attacks are faster.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Enough of that. Do you honestly think that will have any real effect on the Queen?

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: This is a giant mass of nanomachines. You're just wasting your energy.
Nayuta silently continues her attacks.
Mirror keeps talking beside her.
She speaks of how foolish and meaningless it is.
However, Nayuta swings her hands without responding.
Mirror keeps talking beside her.
Nayuta just keeps silently destroying her surroundings.
Mirror notices that something is strange.
It looks like she's just causing random destruction, but there's actually a pattern.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: ... Wait. Nayuta, are you...?
Oh, I should make mention of one more thing.
Because Young Lady Mirror showed unto me the whole of this place,
I have a perfect knowledge of the location of everything within the Queen.
... Though I admit, I did lose my way for a time.
*Clang!*
A clang of metal rings out, and a wide space opens before Nayuta.
In front of her is the Ultra Massive Core.
The core flickers and gleams like a heart.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: No way...

lines.speaker: nayuta_a
lines.text: Hyaaah!
*Clang!*
A blast of force from Nayuta's palm strikes the Ultra Massive Core.
The core shakes.
She strikes it again.
*Clang!*
The core shakes again. Several cables connected to it break off.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Are you insane? You must know this is a twin core.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: If you break this, you'll destroy the Ark's core too. They won't even be able to turn the lights on.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: You made it that way. Did you forget?

lines.speaker: nayuta_a
lines.text: Hyaaah!
*Clang!*
*Crack!*
A crack appears in the core where Nayuta's blow lands.
Nayuta looks over the core.
She then closes her eyes and brings her hands together.
Cold blue light seeps from her body.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: What, you think it's okay now that the Ark has ascended?

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: How foolish. If they lose their core, the Ark will be set back to practically primitive times. They'll never be able to—

lines.speaker: nayuta_a
lines.text: Hup...!

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Wait...!
She stretches her hands out as if throwing herself forward.
*Boom!*
The wall breaks with a loud clang.
It opens up into a long hallway,
at the end of which is a view of the surface.

lines.speaker: nayuta_a
lines.text: *Huff...! Huff...!*

lines.speaker: nayuta_a
lines.text: Ngh...!
Nayuta's face twists in pain.
Still, her eyes focus on the Ultra Massive Core and the long hallway.
There's a crunching sound as the hallway starts to restore itself.
Nayuta once again uses her whole body as she thrusts her hands forward.

lines.speaker: nayuta_a
lines.text: Aaaahhh!
*Clang!*

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: What's that? I just saw something red come out of the body.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: The core...?

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: What, is it laying eggs now?
Marian runs.
In a moment, she leaps over the railing.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Where are you going?!
Marian falls.
She angles herself toward the Ultra Massive Core poking out of the statue's body.
She brings her limbs in close to decrease her air resistance and starts to fall even faster.
The ground rushes up at her. She can clearly see the core.
On top of the core, looking almost dead, is Nayuta.
As she falls, Marian examines the Goddess of Victory statue.
A legion of tentacles reach out toward the Ultra Massive Core.
Marian adjusts her posture and grabs her staff.
As she slams onto the core in a near crash landing, she strikes down with her staff.
The statues' tentacles cling to the core.
At the other end of them, Mirror watches Nayuta with a frantic look on her face.
Oh, I would add one last word.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Die, fiends.
Dark Matter bursts from Marian's body.
It forms an enormous black wave.
It swallows up the core and goes rushing away.
The core grows steadily farther and farther from the statue.
The tentacles grasp only empty air.

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: That was close.
Mirror looks at Marian and Nayuta and lets out a scream.
Marian starts to make enormous black spears and throw them at the statue.
She throws spear after spear, hitting her mark again and again.
Mirror keeps shouting something,
but Marian doesn't show even the slightest bit of interest, instead opting to silently continue launching spears.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Young Lady... Marian...

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: Nayuta! Are you...?

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Didst thou meet... the Great... Hero...?

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: ... Yes, I did.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: I must have... a word with... the pair of thee...

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: Just rest for now. You're a complete mess.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Upon pain of death... I must tell thee...
Marian turns away.
She sees Trombe racing toward the Goddess of Victory statue.
When she sees Crown and Chime,
she is nearly moved to tears as she remembers the night they rode across that meadow.
She looks back at Nayuta, who appears lifeless.
After grabbing Nayuta, she charges forward.
She aims for the hole created by the Ultra Massive Core.
Trombe runs.
The statue grows closer. It's no less intimidating seeing it a second time.
After we race for a while, we see the bottom of the statue explode.
The explosion comes from the inside. I tense up, expecting to see another flood of Raptures emerging.
However, all that emerges from the hole is the red Ultra Massive Core.
That looks like... the Ark's power source...
The core plummets to the ground, and Marian falls on top of it.
She creates the same black wave that we rode on before, lifts the core, and moves away.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: ...! Commander! Look...!
Yeah! Someone must've detached the core from the inside!
And Marian hurled it far away!

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: Marian...!

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: It must've been that crazy monk! I knew she would do it!
That must not be its only power source, or else it would've collapsed already!

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: Still, I'll bet it's much weaker now.
The most important thing is whether or not that gravity field is still active!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: I think we'll find out if we can get closer!
You're right! Onward, Trombe!

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Careful, Rapscallion! You don't get to give orders to our horse!

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: I don't see a problem with granting Advisor permission.
Trombe gallops until the statue is right in front of us. It stretches above us like a wall.
Rapi! See if you can make us an opening!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Roger!
Rapi jumps down from the racing Trombe.
Before she can touch the ground, she activates Seven Dwarves Zero and flies as though scraping the ground.
After overtaking us, she activates her drill and charges forward.
I watch her nervously.
Her drill meets the statue's surface.
*Krrrkkk!*
It worked! The gravity field isn't working anymore!
Rapi's drill digs into the statue.
She presses forward.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Aaaaahhh!
*Krrrkkk!*
*Crunch!*

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: That wrench really is something.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: It's a drill, Your Highness!
Rapi's drill creates a hole,
and we charge through it to the other side.

lines.speaker: sora_op_r
lines.text: We have confirmation that the Queen's gravity field is offline!

lines.speaker: cielo_op_l
lines.text: Its regeneration has greatly slowed down, too!

lines.speaker: sky_op_c
lines.text: Haha! How do you like that?!

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Scarlet, it's time to get to work.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: Long have I waited for this moment.
Scarlet slowly walks to the end of the deck.
She looks down on the statue.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: ... I shall cut thy throat again, Queen.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Enough with the theatrics! Get down there! We're in a hurry!

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: Is this really the time for that? I swear.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: Don't just stand there! You'll get hit!

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: ... I thank ye all for your words of encouragement.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: I shall return.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: What souvenirs are you going to bring us?

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: Will the Queen's head suffice?

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: I should say so.
Scarlet crouches and leaps.
She brings her hands to her scabbard.
Before she lands on the statue, there's a flash from her scabbard.
*Crack!*
She pierces a clean hole in the Queen's surface.
Scarlet flings herself into the hole.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Queen...!

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: We will end this once and for all.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Prepare yourself!

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: Commander...!

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: Now, bare thy throat.
*Flash!*
Red light flickers from the statue's body.
A shock wave bursts out.
Red cores gleam all over the statue's body as they awaken.
Beams shoot from each one of them.
*Kreeeeeee!*
Hundreds of lasers dye the surface red.
*Kreeeeeee!*
The shade of the red deepens.
*Kreeeeeee!*

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: What...?!

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: Brace for impact!

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Aaaagh!
Dozens of beams sweep over us.
Trombe changes direction,
but the beams change trajectory and follow us.
What the...?!
*Boom!*
The red light explodes.
I feel the sensation of floating, then falling.
As I feel myself falling, I see the sky.
It's covered in red beams.
*Kreeeeeee!*

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: Curses...!
Scarlet raises her sword and blocks the beams.
However, she's unable to fully absorb the shock and gets knocked up into the air.
Dozens of beams adjust their tracks and follow her.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: ... What trickery is this?
The lasers overtake Scarlet.
*Kreeeeeee!*

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: Ngh... Ahh...!
The red beams pummel Marian.
She doesn't even have time to use her Dark Matter.
They strike her again and again as she desperately tries to protect Nayuta.
*Kreeeeeee!*
Eventually, she's being pounded by a flurry of lasers.
Even as she falls to the ground, the lasers continue to follow her.
*Kreeeeeee!*

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: My shield won't last for long! There's too many of them!

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Hang in there, Rapunzel!

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: Like I said, there's too many!

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: It still has... so much power...!

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Now's not the time for admiration! Do something with your Heretic power!

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: "Heretic power" isn't just some—

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: Oh no...! All the lasers are being focused into a single point!
*Kreeeeeee!*
A barrage of beams gather together at a single point.
They're aiming for the Wings of Victory's bridge.
Golden light spreads from Rapunzel's halo.
She quickly jumps up and moves in front of the bridge.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: I'll block it!
Rapunzel creates several layers of shields.
The Goddess Squad emblem gleams gold.
*Kreeeeeee!*
The concentrated collection of beams move around Rapunzel's shield.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: What...?!

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Did those beams just change course? You've got to be kidding!

lines.speaker: sky_op_c
lines.text: Everyone! Brace for impact!

lines.speaker: cielo_op_l
lines.text: H-how?

lines.speaker: sky_op_c
lines.text: I don't know! Just hold on to something!
*Boooom!*
The concentrated beams aim for the Wings of Victory's wing.
With an explosion and a cloud of smoke, the ship's balance is thrown off.

lines.speaker: sky_op_c
lines.text: We've been hit on port! We're losing altitude!

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: Tch...!

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Damn that thing...!
*Kreeeeeee!*

lines.speaker: sky_op_c
lines.text: Eek! They're coming again!

lines.speaker: sora_op_r
lines.text: Take it in the underbelly!

lines.speaker: sky_op_c
lines.text: Aye, aye!
The ship tilts vertically.
The layers of anti-beam armor on the underbelly block the beams.
As soon as the armor is struck, it releases gas that lowers the temperature, reducing the damage.

lines.speaker: sora_op_r
lines.text: It worked! Great thinking, Sky!

lines.speaker: sky_op_c
lines.text: We can't hold out for long! There's too many!

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: I'll help!

lines.speaker: sky_op_c
lines.text: W-we're losing altitude! Prepare for an emergency landing!
The Wings of Victory falls.
On the shaking deck, Andersen looks up with rage at the Goddess of Victory statue.
The beams don't stop. They keep firing.
Soon, the look in his eyes turns to one of shock.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: It was indeed unfortunate to lose the Ultra Massive Core.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: But there's something you may not have realized.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: The Queen hadn't used even the smallest bit of her own power.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: She was only drawing power from the Ultra Massive Core.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Now...

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: It's time for you to feel the Queen's full power.
A familiar sound rings out,
that terrible noise that starts as light gathers at the top of the statue.
The sky turns red.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: ... That thing is a monster.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: It's the giant beam again...!
The statue's neck gathers energy to it,
pointed in the exact direction of the Ark.
